description: Motionmaxxing 12 Measured Eases calibrated for EffectCraft (.ecpreset / Keyframe Velocity) and FilmCraft Bezier curves
source: Measured frame-by-frame from 53 high-end commercial motion films (Tejashmakwana/motionmaxxing)

presets.name: snapSettle
presets.description: Default hero entry curve: 54% of spatial travel in the first 10% of time, followed by an elegant long settling tail. Never bounces.
presets.rule: Use for primary hero products, major headline arrivals, and central modal surfaces. Things arrive decelerating from oversize or high velocity, settling with quiet confidence.

presets.name: softLand
presets.description: Firm decelerating exponential settle. The primary workhorse curve for interface text lines, secondary cards, and UI panels.
presets.rule: Standard ease for staggered typography and layout cards. Decelerates gracefully without sluggishness.

presets.name: crashIn
presets.description: Hits and slightly passes its target mark almost immediately (peak 1.18 at t~0.27), snapping into resting state.
presets.rule: Use for tactile stamps, notification popups, pin drops, and sharp physical hits. Must be paired with a sub impact sound.

presets.name: whip
presets.description: Violently decelerating power-out move for large screen-traversing translations and whip-pan handoffs.
presets.rule: For directional transitions, high-velocity camera pans, and large wipes across the frame.

presets.name: glide
presets.description: Gentle, organic power-out ease for medium camera adjustments, floating badges, and secondary elements.
presets.rule: Ideal for camera tracking or subtle positional reframing while reading.

presets.name: popOver
presets.description: Calculated delayed overshoot (peak 1.08 at t~0.72) driven by an underdamped harmonic spring.
presets.rule: Use at most once per film for playful interactive highlights, toggle switches, or badges.

presets.name: bounceHard
presets.description: High-energy spring overshoot (1.48 peak) with secondary oscillations. Use very sparingly.
presets.rule: Cartoon / high-energy product features only. Never use on serious enterprise software.

presets.name: cruise
presets.description: Pure linear velocity (f(t)=t) for continuous background camera drift, number tickers, and Ken Burns scaling.
presets.rule: For background footage drift and slow continuous zoom (100% -> 104%) across an entire scene.

presets.name: softInOut
presets.description: Symmetric, low-contrast S-curve optimized for crossfades, defocus blur transitions, and luma dissolves.
presets.rule: For opacity and Gaussian blur transitions between scenes. Prevents abrupt luminance dips.

presets.name: gentleIn
presets.description: Mild acceleration curve for beginning an exit move or anticipation before a big transition.
presets.rule: For smooth start of multi-stage movements.

presets.name: accelExit
presets.description: The standard departure curve. Accelerates sharply off screen, ensuring the eye never waits for an exiting element.
presets.rule: Standard exit curve for all cards and text. Exits must accelerate away rapidly, clearing the frame for the next beat.

presets.name: crashOut
presets.description: Extreme acceleration into a hard scene cut or shutter slam.
presets.rule: For dramatic departures that cut immediately to black or a high-contrast hero proof.
